run.author: Grok Bot (Run 3)
run.focus: Consumer (B2C/prosumer/family) sweep + rubric v2 (AI-buildability for a non-engineer)
sources_swept: Indie seating-chart tools (Tablee, Seatful, SeatCanvas, Seat Smart, Lovely Seating)
EtsyHunt + Toolsy Etsy planner best-seller data
Google Time Insights + OAuth sensitive scope docs
run.notes: Rubric v2.0 introduced this run (migrate_v2.py backfilled aibuild + customer_type for all 100 earlier ideas before this merge; see runs/run3_rubric_v2_rescore.json). Reddit not fetched directly; no Reddit-only claims used. Etsy sales figures are third-party estimates (EtsyHunt) and labelled so.

ideas.title: Drag-and-drop seating chart planner
ideas.problem: Seating charts are painful, with constraints (couples, feuds, dietary flags)
ideas.monetisation: Free to ~40 guests; one-time Event Pass per event; optional planner annual plan later
ideas.price_hypothesis: US$19-29 per event (A$29-39); planner plan US$79-99/yr later

evidence.note: Tablee (iPhone, live 24 Aug 2026): free to 5 tables, $8.99 per event, Pro $79.99/yr
Seatful: free to 40 guests, $14.99 one-time Event Pass incl. RSVP link, caterer report, QR find-your-seat
SeatCanvas: free to 40 seated guests, $19.99 one-time; says subscription rivals cost $60-120 over an engagement
Seat Smart: free to 20 guests, $19/event (150), $49/event unlimited, guest self-select seats
Lovely Seating (updated 14 Oct 2026): Free, Pro $39 one-time, Agency $79/mo for planners
EtsyHunt (1 Oct 2026): wedding planner spreadsheet incl. seating plan = #2 digital planner, 10,915 sales, $104,457 revenue (third-party estimate)
Etsy wedding planner spreadsheets $9.70-9.99 with 11.3k-12.6k reviews

ideas.notes: R3: compete 3->2 (at least 5 indie one-time seating tools priced $8.99-49, several launched in 2026, likely AI-built too: proves demand and buildability, but differentiation must be sharp: AU/UK wording 'table plan', constraint solver ('keep apart'), caterer/meal report, escort-card print, non-wedding events). synergy 3->4 (seeds the consumer local-first planner shell). aibuild 4: drag-drop canvas + PDF export are well-trodden.

ideas.title: Calendar time audit: where did my week go
ideas.problem: People and managers can't see how meeting time splits across projects/clients without manual tallying
ideas.target_users: Managers, consultants, freelancers billing by client

evidence.note: Google Calendar Time Insights: only for eligible work/school accounts, not personal Gmail
calendar.readonly is a sensitive scope: Google app verification required, no CASA security assessment
MyCalendarStats: upload .ics or connect Google, browser-local time analytics (direct competitor)
'Where does my time go?' iOS: manual journaling time tracker

ideas.notes: R3: unchanged scores. Google's own Time Insights is only for work/school accounts, so personal Gmail users have a gap. OAuth calendar.readonly is a sensitive scope (Google verification, no CASA) -> aibuild 3. Build the consumer version as ics-time-audit first.

ideas.title: Calendar time audit from an .ics file (no login)
ideas.problem: People want to know where their week goes, but Google's Time Insights isn't available on personal accounts and OAuth apps feel invasive.
ideas.target_users: Freelancers, students, parents, anyone with a busy personal Google/Apple/Outlook calendar
ideas.monetisation: Free one-month report; paid unlock for all-time trends, custom categories, weekly email via the private iCal URL
ideas.price_hypothesis: US$9-15 one-time, or US$3/mo for weekly digest

evidence.note: MyCalendarStats: upload .ics or connect Google, browser-local time analytics (direct competitor)
Google Calendar Time Insights: only for eligible work/school accounts, not personal Gmail
calendar.readonly is a sensitive scope: Google app verification required, no CASA security assessment
'Where does my time go?' iOS: manual journaling time tracker

ideas.notes: Fastest path to the time-audit idea for a non-engineer: parse a user-exported .ics in the browser (no OAuth, no server data). Later: paste the calendar's 'secret iCal address' for weekly refresh without Google verification. Competitor MyCalendarStats already does upload analytics, so win on categories ('meetings vs family vs exercise'), week-over-week change and shareable cards.

ideas.title: School holiday & leave planner for AU parents
ideas.problem: Working parents juggle 12 weeks of school holidays, two employers' leave balances and grandparents; spreadsheets every term.
ideas.monetisation: Free planner; paid 'family plan' with shared link, .ics export, leave balance tracking, holiday-program notes

evidence.note: CalmCo free School Holiday Planner (NSW etc.), split each break, export calendar
AU school holiday annual leave planner/calculator (free)
NSW 2027 official term dates (public data source)

ideas.notes: Low legal (public term dates, no child names needed). Seasonal SEO 4x/yr ('NSW school holidays 2027'). Must update term dates yearly per state. Keep custody features out (see custody-holiday-calendar).

ideas.title: Co-parent holiday split planner
ideas.problem: Separated parents need to split school holidays and special days fairly and see it on one calendar.

evidence.note: OurFamilyWizard: $110-299.88/yr per parent
AppClose: $7.99/mo per parent (web)
CalmCo free School Holiday Planner (NSW etc.), split each break, export calendar

ideas.notes: Pain and WTP are real (OFW charges each parent), but records can end up in family-court disputes and hold children's schedules -> legal 2. Not killed, but don't build first.

ideas.title: Funeral order-of-service & first-week planner
ideas.problem: Families have about a week to plan a service, write a program and coordinate tasks while grieving.
ideas.monetisation: One-time per service: printable order of service + checklist

evidence.note: Funeral Planning Kit: 7-day timeline, budget sheets, 4 order-of-service templates
Funeral Program Maker: order-of-service templates + checklist (SEO competitor)
Etsy 33-page funeral service planner PDF

ideas.notes: Acute, episodic pain with clear one-off WTP. Sensitive tone; no pricing advice on funeral homes. Template + print layout is AI-friendly. Distribution via SEO ('order of service template') and celebrants.

ideas.title: Moving box QR labels & contents list
ideas.problem: After a move nobody knows which box has the kettle; labels get vague.
ideas.monetisation: Free 10 boxes; one-time unlock per move

evidence.note: SpectrTech Moving Planner: $29 once, offline QR box labels (Product Hunt launch)
BoxBuddy: free to 10 boxes then $19.99/yr

ideas.notes: Pairs with moving-house-checklist-au as a bundle. Hard part: a phone scan must show contents without a server (encode contents in the QR or a static share link).

ideas.title: Wedding guest list, RSVP & budget hub (upsell of the seating planner)
ideas.problem: Couples run guest lists, RSVPs, meals and budgets in 3-4 spreadsheets that feed the seating chart.
ideas.monetisation: Bundle with the seating Event Pass

evidence.note: EtsyHunt (1 Oct 2026): wedding planner spreadsheet incl. seating plan = #2 digital planner, 10,915 sales, $104,457 revenue (third-party estimate)
Etsy wedding planner spreadsheets $9.70-9.99 with 11.3k-12.6k reviews
Seatful: free to 40 guests, $14.99 one-time Event Pass incl. RSVP link, caterer report, QR find-your-seat

ideas.notes: Etsy's #2 digital planner is a wedding spreadsheet bundle (10.9k sales, third-party estimate). Free incumbents (Zola/The Knot) -> compete 1. Best as module 2 of the seating planner rather than standalone.

ideas.title: No-limits trip & share-house expense splitter (web, no accounts)
ideas.problem: Splitwise's free tier caps entries per day with ad waits; groups want a simple shared ledger for one trip.
ideas.monetisation: Free one group; one-time unlock for unlimited groups/exports

evidence.note: Mint: Splitwise free tier capped at ~4 entries/day with 10s ad waits; Splitkaro claims 50k MAU, ~2% paid
Lifehacker AU (Feb 2024): Splitwise limits; free alternatives Tricount, Settle Up, Splid ($3-4 one-time), SplitMyExpenses

ideas.notes: Records who owes what; never moves money (moving money = kill). Free incumbents (Tricount) keep wtp at 2. Shared ledger needs a small DB with Supabase RLS done right (see CVE-2025-48757).

ideas.title: Hens/bucks weekend planner (dates poll, run sheet, who-owes-what)
ideas.problem: The organiser chases 12 people for dates, money and RSVPs over WhatsApp.

evidence.note: Nowa (AU): free date voting, RSVPs, run sheets and cost settlement for bucks/hens
Buxmate: bucks/hens itinerary, RSVPs, cost splitting

ideas.notes: Several AU-specific competitors already. Multi-user voting/real-time -> aibuild 3.

ideas.title: Group trip planner with voting
ideas.problem: Group trips stall on decisions and scattered links.

evidence.note: TrekUnity: free group trip planner (votes, itinerary, splitting)
Tripplo: group trips $3.99/mo or $39.90/yr

ideas.notes: Crowded and VC-funded; affiliate-driven. Skip.

ideas.title: Kids' birthday party planner (run sheet, budget, RSVP)
ideas.problem: Parents plan a party a year per child with lists, invites and a budget.

evidence.note: Kids party invites: Evite free with ads (Pro $249.99/yr), Punchbowl $47.99-95.99/yr

ideas.notes: Invitee lists are other people's children -> legal 3; free invite giants -> compete 1. Fold run-sheet features into event-run-sheet instead.

ideas.title: Christmas/holiday hosting planner: who hosts, who brings what
ideas.problem: Families coordinate dishes, hosting rotation and timings in group chats every December.
ideas.monetisation: Free (SEO feeder); tip jar or bundle with gift-list tracker

evidence.note: Kunbaa: free family Christmas planner (who hosts, who brings what)
GetLadle: potluck/holiday meal dish claims
SignUpGenius: free with ads; paid $11.99-59.99/mo

ideas.notes: Feeder: strong seasonal search, weak WTP. Good cross-sell surface for gift-list-budget-tracker.

ideas.title: Secret Santa with exclusions and no-repeat history
ideas.problem: Families want exclusions and to avoid drawing the same person as last year.

evidence.note: Elfster: free Secret Santa, 40M+ users, monetised by affiliate/sponsored gifts, no paid tier
drawnames: free, no account; 7,061,757 names drawn this year (site counter)

ideas.notes: Elfster (40M+ users) and drawnames are free -> feeder only. Not worth a build except as a viral feeder in December.

ideas.title: Christmas & birthday gift list + budget tracker (year over year)
ideas.problem: People overspend at Christmas and forget what they gave whom last year.

evidence.note: Etsy interactive Christmas gift budget tracker $19
FluVana Christmas budget web app $29
Toolsy: 5,117 Etsy planner-template listings; top-heavy (median listing gained 1 review in 30 days); book tracker, budget sheets, wedding binder in top 10

ideas.notes: Etsy proves WTP for spreadsheets ($19 interactive tracker; FluVana web app $29). Annual history = mild lock-in. Budget tracking only, no financial advice. Extremely AI-buildable.

ideas.title: Baby name shortlist & partner match
ideas.problem: Couples argue over names; want a shared shortlist and private matching.

evidence.note: Kinder: swipe baby names with partner; $0.99 sets / $4.99 all (one-time)

ideas.notes: Saturated, low price -> feeder. No child data (names are just names).

ideas.title: Subscription & free-trial tracker (manual, no bank link)
ideas.problem: People forget trials and renewals but won't connect a bank account.

evidence.note: Bobby: manual subscription tracker, one-time unlocks $0.99-2.99
Rocket Money Premium ~$7-14/mo via bank linking (search summary)

ideas.notes: Feeder: Bobby sells unlocks at $0.99-2.99. Could be a free tool inside a household admin bundle.

ideas.title: Household renewals calendar (rego, passport, insurance, licences)
ideas.problem: Renewal dates live in emails and drawers; missed rego or passport expiry costs real money.

evidence.note: Renewley: passport/rego/insurance expiry reminders, $39.99 one-time
Life Admin: household renewals, $9-15/mo

ideas.notes: Renewley charges $39.99 one-time. Store dates and labels only, never ID numbers (keeps legal at 4). Calendar subscription feed needs a small server -> aibuild 4. Overlaps home-maintenance-reminders; consider merging into one 'home admin calendar'.

ideas.title: Private spending insights from bank CSV exports
ideas.problem: People want to see where money goes without giving bank logins to an app.
ideas.monetisation: One-time unlock for rules, multi-account, yearly report

evidence.note: Spending Insights: free browser-local bank CSV analysis
CategorizeOnce: free open-source local CSV categoriser

ideas.notes: Legal 3: financial data and close to advice; must present facts only, never advice. Several free local tools already. Bank CSV formats vary (maint 3).

ideas.title: Listening history insights from your Spotify export
ideas.problem: Wrapped comes once a year; fans want all-time stats anytime.

evidence.note: stats.fm: Sensor Tower estimates cited at ~$300k/month (2024); Adapty later est. ~$100k/month (estimates, not verified)
Earhours Pro: $5 one-time, parses Spotify export locally
Spotify Extended Streaming History export: lifetime plays, timestamps, skips

ideas.notes: stats.fm proves the category at scale (estimates only), but $5 one-time pricing -> feeder. Avoid Spotify trademarks/'Wrapped' in branding.

ideas.title: Year-in-sport poster from your Strava export
ideas.problem: Athletes want a printable/shareable summary of their year.

evidence.note: VeloViewer: indie Strava analytics PRO GBP10/yr, PRO+ GBP20/yr
StatsHunters: free donation-supported Strava heatmaps

ideas.notes: Uses the user's bulk export (no API terms). Seasonal December spike. Mid score.

ideas.title: Drag-drop vegetable garden bed planner for AU climates
ideas.problem: Home gardeners plan beds and planting times with generic Northern-hemisphere tools.

evidence.note: GrowVeg Garden Planner: US $35/yr auto-renew, $50 1yr, $85 2yr; 7-day trial

ideas.notes: GrowVeg proves annual WTP ($35/yr). AU climate-zone angle is the wedge. Planting data must be curated and checked (AI can draft but can't be trusted blindly); avoid any plant toxicity/edibility safety claims.

ideas.title: 'Will it fit' room & furniture planner
ideas.problem: Buying a couch without knowing if it fits.

evidence.note: Free Room Planner: free 2D/3D, no account
Floorspacer: EUR 10 one-time full catalogue
Planner 5D Premium $4.99/mo annual

ideas.notes: Many free tools -> feeder.

ideas.title: Gallery wall layout & nail-position planner
ideas.problem: Hanging a set of frames means measuring, guessing and extra holes in the wall.

evidence.note: GalleryPlanner web: free core, Pro passes $6-20 or $99 lifetime (PDF hanging guide)
WallHang iPhone: Pro $7.99 one-time

ideas.notes: Same drag-drop canvas as the seating planner (high reuse). Competitors exist at $7.99-19.99. Nice second product on the planner shell.

ideas.title: Capsule wardrobe & outfit planner
ideas.problem: People own a lot and wear little.

evidence.note: Whering/Indyx free; Stylebook $4.99 one-time; Indyx Insider $74.99/yr

ideas.notes: Saturated with free apps; image cut-outs add complexity.

ideas.title: Exam revision timetable generator (Year 12 / uni)
ideas.problem: Students build revision timetables by hand around exams and work shifts.
ideas.target_users: Senior high school (16+) and uni students

evidence.note: My Revision Planner: GBP49 one-off
Memio revision timetables GBP4.99/mo

ideas.notes: Target 16+ and uni to avoid children's data (rule 4). Seasonal (exam periods). Scheduling logic is testable with fixtures.

ideas.title: Footy tipping comp organiser (no money)
ideas.problem: Office/family tipping comps run on spreadsheets or ad-heavy free apps.
ideas.monetisation: Free small comps; paid branded comps

evidence.note: ESPN Footytips: free private comps, no paid organiser tier
Round Won: free to 10 tippers, then $10/competition (also handles entry fees - we would not)
TippingHQ: free under 10 tippers, paid from $279/season (club/business)

ideas.notes: Never touch entry fees or payouts (gambling/holding money = kill). Fixture data licensing and weekly maintenance in season. Weak.

ideas.title: Board game collection & play log
ideas.problem: Collectors track games and plays across BGG and spreadsheets.

evidence.note: BoardHub Pro $2.99/mo or $29.99/yr
GameSquire EUR 3.99/mo or EUR 29.99/yr

ideas.notes: BGG data terms create platform risk. Crowded.

ideas.title: Book club organiser (polls, schedule, host rotation)
ideas.problem: Book clubs juggle dates, picks and hosts in group chats.

evidence.note: Bookclubs: Premium $60/club/yr, Pro $180/yr

ideas.notes: Bookclubs charges $60/club/yr; a simpler cheaper version could work but pain is mild.

ideas.title: Family recipe cookbook PDF maker
ideas.problem: Families want Grandma's recipes in one printable book for a birthday/Christmas gift.

evidence.note: RecipePrinter: $19.99 once per cookbook PDF
ReciScan: printed family cookbooks from ~$18

ideas.notes: Gift-driven, seasonal. Print layout is the hard part (AI handles HTML-to-PDF reasonably).

ideas.title: Weekly family meal planner + grocery list (no diet advice)
ideas.problem: Deciding dinners and writing the shopping list every week.

evidence.note: Plan to Eat: bootstrapped, profitable 15+ yrs, $5.95/mo or $49/yr
Paprika: one-time per-platform recipe manager with meal planning

ideas.notes: Plan to Eat shows a bootstrapped business can last 15+ yrs. Very crowded; legal 4 only if it never gives nutrition/diet advice.

ideas.title: Home contents inventory for insurance claims
ideas.problem: After a burglary or flood people can't list what they owned.

evidence.note: Encircle consumer home inventory app shut down 17 Dec 2025; Sortly is business-priced
Streamline Claims: free, Plus $4.99/mo home inventory for claims

ideas.notes: Gap after Encircle's consumer app closed (Dec 2025). Photos + values are sensitive personal data -> legal 3; never advise on cover amounts.

ideas.title: House & pet sitter handover guide builder
ideas.problem: Owners rewrite the same instructions every trip.

evidence.note: Etsy 14-page house/pet sitter instructions printable

ideas.notes: Feeder; bundle with pet-care-shared-log.

ideas.title: Houseplant watering schedule
ideas.problem: Plants die from irregular watering.

evidence.note: Planta Premium $7.99/mo or $35.99/yr

ideas.notes: Planta proves subscriptions ($35.99/yr) but the space is saturated with AI plant-ID apps.

ideas.title: Media kit & rate card builder for small creators
ideas.problem: Small creators need a professional one-page media kit with live stats for brand pitches.

evidence.note: Canva free media-kit templates (strong free option)
Etsy creator media-kit templates ~$9-16

ideas.notes: Canva's free templates cap WTP; manual stats entry avoids platform APIs.

ideas.problem: Inbox overload from newsletters.

evidence.note: Gmail restricted scopes require CASA security assessment

ideas.problem: Parents track chores and pocket money.
